# Ezerhealthcare - Clinical Intelligence Ecosystem

> Ezerhealthcare unites high-performance EHR workflows, automated remote monitoring, and ambient AI scribing into a single, clinical-grade ecosystem designed to eliminate data fragmentation.

## About Ezerhealthcare
Ezerhealthcare by Ezer Labs is an interoperable engine designed to eliminate healthcare fragmentation. We build clinical-first systems where artificial intelligence operates with surgical accuracy and ironclad security. Our mission is to reduce clinician burnout, eliminate administrative overhead ("pajama time"), and elevate patient care through real-time ambient intelligence.

## Core Products & Modules

### 1. Ambient AI Clinical Scribe (/clinical-scribe)
- **Overview**: An ambient intelligence tool that listens to doctor-patient conversations in the background and generates perfectly structured SOAP notes in real-time.
- **Key Features**: Automated SOAP categorization (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan), medical terminology fine-tuning, HIPAA & GDPR secure with zero audio retention, SOC2 Type II certified.
- **Interoperability**: Native one-click sync to Epic and Cerner via FHIR/HL7 standards.
- **Workflow Steps**: 1. Record before entering exam room. 2. Converse naturally while AI filters out irrelevant small talk. 3. Review and approve formatted SOAP note in seconds.

### 2. Intelligent EHR (/ehr)
- **Overview**: Modern, lightning-fast Electronic Health Record interface built on zero-trust security and FHIR-native interoperability.
- **Key Features**: One-click medication reconciliation, automated ICD-10/CPT coding assistance, real-time longitudinal patient timeline, longitudinal clinical graph with vital trends.
- **Security**: Zero-trust architecture, end-to-end encryption, HIPAA compliant.

### 3. Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) (/rpm)
- **Overview**: Automated physiological monitoring platform connecting cellular IoT medical devices directly to clinical dashboards.
- **Key Features**: Real-time biometric tracking (blood pressure, glucose, SpO2, heart rate), automated CCM billing logs (CPT 99453, 99454, 99457), dynamic risk stratification, multi-channel alert escalation (SMS, Push, EHR inbox).

## Technical Specifications & Compliance
- **Interoperability**: FHIR-native APIs, HL7 v2/v3 support, Smart on FHIR compatible.
- **Security**: HIPAA compliant, SOC2 Type II certified, GDPR compliant, zero-trust infrastructure with encrypted transit (TLS 1.3) and at-rest (AES-256).
- **AI Ethics**: Zero patient audio retention after synthesis. No PHI training data leakage.
